text: He said that the Athenians did not honor him or admire him, but made, as it were, a sort of plane-tree of him; sheltered themselves under him in bad weather, and, as soon as it was fine, plucked his leaves and cut his branches.
author: Plutarch
speaker: Themistocles
translation: John Dryden et al., rev. Arthur Hugh Clough, 1864
